text:
jonathan: Hey team — PR 8432 is blocked, can someone quick-eye the failing smoke-inference-e2e on buildkite? It flakes locally for me but I'm not sure if it's infra or my change to batching config. buildkite link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/pipelines/infra/builds/472
buildkite: Build #472 — FAILED — test: smoke-inference-e2e (exit 1)
jonathan: error snippet from the job:
```
E 00:12:45.123 inference_runner.cpp:452] Assertion failed: kv_cache.size() == expected_kv_size (got=1024 expected=2048)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/smoke/test_inference.py", line 87, in test_smoke_inference
    assert result.success
AssertionError
```
ci-bot: Detected possible flake: test failure rate 12% over last 50 runs for smoke-inference-e2e.
maria: taking a look now :eyes: can you paste the PR link?
jonathan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8432 — the only functional change was a tiny tweak to batching heuristics and a guard in kv eviction.
sam: I can kick a rerun if that helps, want me to restart build 472?
maria: yes please, rerun first. if it goes green maybe it's transient. If it fails consistently we should bisect.
sam: rerun requested... buildkite: Re-run triggered for build 472 by sam
buildkite: Build #473 — RUNNING
andre: pinging in — I wrote the KV eviction patch last week. Quick guess: the guard may not account for empty-prefix caching when seq len==1. Can you grep for related test inputs?
jonathan: here's the failing test case payload (trimmed):
```json
{"prompt": "hello", "max_tokens": 4, "prefix_cache": []}
```
maria: thanks. @andre can you check if eviction logic early-returns when prefix_cache empty? That would explain smaller kv size.
andre: looking now. I see a suspicious early-return in runtime/kv_cache.cc around the new check. Pulling locally to reproduce.
andre: quick local run reproduced the assertion once out of 5 runs. Adding a guard to ensure kv_cache.reserve(expected_kv_size) before eviction. I'll push a tiny fix to my branch and ask jonathan to rebase.
jonathan: pushed fix to the PR, force-pushed with a better check and a unit test that hits empty-prefix path.
jonathan: force-push done: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8432/files
sam: rerunning build 473 after rebase... buildkite: Re-run triggered for build 473 by sam
buildkite: Build #474 — RUNNING
buildkite: Build #474 — PASSED 
jonathan: green! thanks all. i'll merge after I verify the changelog entry. Appreciate the quick eyes :tada:
maria: nice find, @andre. I'll add a short note in the rollout doc about edge-case cache sizes.
andre: np, glad it was a quick one.
jonathan: merging now.
